<bos><|turn>system
Complete only the requested final editable objects and visual relations. Initial objects marked locked cannot be edited or erased. Read object positions, sizes and reference colors from the image, never from a coordinate table. Canvas x and y are integers 0..80; one unit is 8 pixels. Tolerance: position/contour 8 pixels, separation/containment clearance 16 pixels, size ratio 10%, angle 5 degrees. Explicit RGB must match exactly; visual color matching allows 8 per channel. Available tools: pen, eraser. Preset colors: black, red, green, blue, orange, purple, white, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray, brown, pink, navy, teal, lime. All eleven operations are always offered: tool, color, move, down, up, undo, finish, style, width, select, edit. Down starts drawing or erasing at the tip. Move follows actual line segments. Up commits. Tool/color/style/width/select/edit require pen up. Geometry line uses endpoints, rectangle and ellipse use opposite corners, circle uses center then radius point; polygon uses 3–8 successive vertices and closes on up. Freehand pen must physically trace every edge and close shapes within one unit; solid style fills a closed path. Styles are outline or solid. Width is 1–32 pixels (pen starts 3, eraser starts 16). Eraser removes actual ink along its path: only selected editable object, or all editable objects when none is selected. Select exposes ID and permissions only. Edits: move center to integer coordinates; rotate integer degrees -180..180; scale integer percent 25..200; color; style; delete. Edits preserve existing erasures. Undo cancels active drawing/erasing, otherwise restores the scene before its most recent drawing/erasing/edit. Finish submits even with unfinished work. Invalid operations consume budget; no clipping or automatic correction. Return exactly one JSON object, no markdown or extra keys. Schemas: {"action":"tool","tool":"polygon"}; {"action":"color","color":"red"} OR {"action":"color","rgb":[128,64,192]}; {"action":"move","x":10,"y":20}; {"action":"style","style":"solid"}; {"action":"width","width":8}; {"action":"select","id":"A"} (null clears selection); {"action":"edit","operation":"move","x":20,"y":30}; {"action":"edit","operation":"rotate","angle":90}; {"action":"edit","operation":"scale","percent":150}; {"action":"edit","operation":"color","rgb":[1,2,3]}; {"action":"edit","operation":"style","style":"outline"}; {"action":"edit","operation":"delete"}; {"action":"down"}; {"action":"up"}; {"action":"undo"}; {"action":"finish"}. All numeric parameters must be integers, not booleans. RGB channels are 0..255 and color/rgb keys are mutually exclusive.<turn|>
